title: status/report --run and ACTIVE are not validated: path traversal writes status.md outside the runs dir
detail: resolveRun joins any --run value or ACTIVE contents onto the runs dir and only checks existence; renderStatusFile then overwrites <that dir>/status.md. `status --run ../../..` overwrote a user's status.md; `--run ''` renders the runs dir; a tampered ACTIVE does the same via report.
fix_hint: Validate RUN_ID for the flag and the ACTIVE value in resolveRun and check the resolved dir stays under runsDir; exit 1 otherwise. Tests for --run '../x', --run '' and a tampered ACTIVE.

title: An existing local path containing whitespace is classified as paste
detail: The whitespace→paste check runs before the existence check, so a real directory like '/Users/x/My Tool' becomes type=paste with identity sha256 of the path string, marked fetched, next=inventory.
fix_hint: Check exists(path.resolve(text)) for single-line text before the whitespace heuristic. Add a classifySource test with a directory name containing a space.

title: A non-existent path or schemeless URL is silently treated as a one-word paste
detail: './missing/dir' or 'github.com/foo/bar' fall through to paste; the run is created with fetched=true and ACTIVE moves to it. The user never gets an error.
fix_hint: Paste positional text only when it contains whitespace or a newline; refuse a single path-like or host-like token that does not exist or has no scheme, with a hint to use --as paste or a full URL.

title: A value flag given with no value silently falls back to the default
detail: parseArgs stores true for a bare flag and consumers ignore non-strings: `status --run` renders ACTIVE, `intake src --run` auto-names, bare --as/--slug/--project are dropped, `--paste-file` with no value reads stdin. Unknown flags are accepted.
fix_hint: Declare value flags (run, project, as, slug, paste-file) and fail with usage when one has no string value; reject unknown flags per verb.

title: Manifest identity skips symlinks, so distinct sources collide
detail: Dirent.isFile() is false for symlinks, so a directory holding only a symlink and an empty directory both hash to sha256 of '\n'; lookupSource would then report reuse_from for an unrelated source.
fix_hint: Include symlinks in the manifest as entries (path\t->target) and make an empty manifest an error or salt it. Test a directory containing a symlink.

title: --paste-file silently discards a positional source
detail: With --paste-file set, classifySource returns paste and the positional URL or path is ignored without an error.
fix_hint: Fail with usage when --paste-file is combined with a positional other than '-'. Add a CLI test.

title: Status shows fetch as done for local/paste even though fetch never ran
detail: The spec says fetch for local/paste records a zero-egress row; nextStep instead returns inventory right after intake and the table marks fetch done with no egress row.
fix_hint: Have intake record the zero-egress row itself for local/paste so the done state is true, or derive fetch completion from an egress row. Update tests.

title: Any non-undefined decision counts as decided
detail: nextStep treats null, '' or 'maybe' as decided while summary counts the same power as undecided.
fix_hint: One shared predicate: decided means one of rebuild|use|buy|skip.

title: --paste-file is decoded as UTF-8 before hashing
detail: Invalid UTF-8 bytes become U+FFFD so the identity and paste.txt no longer match the file's real bytes.
fix_hint: Read the paste file as a Buffer; hash and write raw bytes; decode only for the emptiness check.

title: A non-object .claude/bbs.json crashes with an opaque TypeError
detail: bbs.json of null, [] or a scalar makes deepMerge return that value; every verb dies with 'Cannot read properties of null'.
fix_hint: Require a plain object after JSON.parse and throw `invalid config in <file>: expected an object`.

title: Run id date is UTC, not the local date
detail: West of UTC an evening intake gets tomorrow's date, disagreeing with marathon run ids and the user's calendar.
fix_hint: Use the local date, keeping the injected now() for tests.

title: Concurrent intakes can pick the same run id and overwrite each other's run
detail: runIdFor checks existence but the run dir is only created later inside writeJson; nothing claims the id in between. 6 parallel intakes with the same slug: 3 got the same runId, one source.json survived, egress.jsonl collected 4 rows.
fix_hint: Claim the id atomically: fs.mkdir(runDir) without recursive; on EEXIST move to the next -n suffix (for --run, fail). Only then write source.json. Test parallel intakes get distinct ids.

title: source.json is written before the paste and egress row, so an interrupted intake leaves a run that looks complete
detail: source.json (fetched:true) is written first; paste.txt is a plain non-atomic write; a later failure leaves a run that nextStep reports as inventory while paste.txt may be missing or truncated and no longer matches the identity.
fix_hint: Write fetched/paste.txt atomically and the egress row first; write source.json last as the commit marker, or remove the run dir on any failure after the claim.

title: A local git repo with no commits cannot be taken in
detail: isGitRepo only checks .git exists; `git rev-parse HEAD` fails on an unborn HEAD or a missing git binary, intake aborts and git's stderr is printed raw and repeated.
fix_hint: Catch the git failure and fall back to the path+size manifest (or fail with a clear message); use stdio ['ignore','pipe','pipe'] in defaultGit.

title: A literal null row in egress.jsonl crashes status and report
detail: readJsonl keeps any JSON value; a `null` line enters state.egress and the bytes_in reduce dereferences it. lookupSource has the same unguarded access. Corrupt rows are dropped silently.
fix_hint: readJsonl keeps only plain-object rows and counts the rest as corrupt; show the corrupt-row count in status.

title: status.md is written non-atomically and status fails outright on a read-only run dir
detail: renderStatusFile uses a plain writeFile; on EACCES the read-only status verb exits 1 without printing the markdown it already rendered.
fix_hint: Write status.md via the tmp+rename helper; in the status verb print the markdown even when the write fails and warn on stderr.

title: Project root silently falls back to cwd when git is missing or fails
detail: If git is missing, resolveProjectDir uses cwd; from a subdirectory a second .claude/bbs tree is created and later status calls from the root cannot find the run.
fix_hint: Walk up from cwd looking for .git or .claude when git is unavailable, or warn on stderr and point to --project.

title: ACTIVE pointer written non-atomically; a full disk wipes the previous run's pointer
detail: setActiveRun uses fs.writeFile which truncates first; on ENOSPC the old pointer is gone and the rollback cannot restore it (empty reads as null). Every other store write is atomic; this one is not.
fix_hint: setActiveRun via writeTextAtomic(file, runId+'\n'). Test that a failing write leaves the prior ACTIVE intact.

title: Stdin paste is decoded as UTF-8, which corrupts non-UTF-8 bytes and its identity
detail: readStdin decodes to a string so invalid sequences become U+FFFD; different pastes can hash equal and lookupSource reports a false reuse_from; the same bytes via --paste-file get a different identity.
fix_hint: Return a Buffer from readStdin; hash and write raw bytes as --paste-file does; decode only for the emptiness check. Test equal identities for a non-UTF-8 byte via stdin and via --paste-file.

title: Without a git checkout, the marker walk silently roots the project at ~/.claude
detail: Every Claude Code user has ~/.claude, so from any non-git directory under $HOME the walk stops at $HOME with no warning and runs land in ~/.claude/bbs.
fix_hint: Skip os.homedir() when matching the .claude marker (or stop the walk at $HOME, keeping only .git there) so the warn-and-use-cwd fallback applies. Test with HOME set to a temp dir containing .claude.

title: Running cli.js through a symlinked path does nothing and exits 0
detail: The main-module guard compares the realpath of import.meta.url with path.resolve(process.argv[1]) which keeps the symlink; through a symlinked dir every verb is a silent no-op with exit 0.
fix_hint: Compare fs.realpathSync of both sides inside try/catch. Test running the CLI through a symlinked directory.

title: Run ids are case-insensitive, so the same --run means one run on macOS and two on Linux
detail: RUN_ID accepts uppercase and explicit ids are stored as given; APFS merges Foo/foo, Linux does not.
fix_hint: Lowercase explicit run ids or reject uppercase by dropping the /i flag.
